text:
alex: Customer (ACCT-1249) opened an escalation — invoice shows ~3x tokens vs their Node SDK estimator. They reported streaming enabled and said the SDK estimate matched prompt+completion locally. invoice includes lots of small system/tool chunks. attaching repro below

maria: Can you paste the exact request? which model and SDK version?

alex: Model: redwood/fast-chat-7b, SDK v1.4.2, stream: true. curl they used: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-chat-7b","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this doc."}]}'
```

josh: quick glance — runtime has a post-run summarizer that appends a short assistant message when stream closes (we added it to improve quality metrics). That appended chunk is counted by billing tokenization but the SDK estimator currently only counts the original messages. also tool hooks can inject small telemetry blocks.

maria: ah ok. do we add those server injections into invoices? billing pipeline uses server-side tokenizer over final preserved transcript (includes any runtime-inserted assistant messages and tool outputs). so yes, those are billable.

alex: customer is confused because SDK estimator doesn't reflect those server-side insertions. they call streaming stop while server later adds a "assistant_summary" message.

ingrid: filing billing ticket BL-2412 to document and follow up with finance. short-term: we should provide a repro + explanation to customer and a suggestion for SDK change. sre-bot: created BL-2412 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BL-2412) :white_check_mark:

maria: proposal: SDK add an opt-in flag `include_server_injections` (default false) and an explanation in docs that final invoice uses server-side transcript including system/tool injections. Also add an end-to-end unit test that runs with stream=true and asserts estimate >= server count.

josh: engineering action: runtime team can add a header `X-Invoice-Injections: true` to responses that include post-run appends so SDKs can surface it in logs. I'll open a runtime PR to emit that header and a follow-up to remove secret telemetry text from assistant_summary (make it shorter).

alex: i'll send customer the repro + explanation and offer to re-run their session with injection header off for billing reconciliation. assigning @maria + @josh to BL-2412. thanks :thumbsup:
